questions.title: Explain bubble sort

questions.title: Explain merge sort
questions.question: How does merge sort work? Walk me through it on [38, 27, 43, 3, 9, 82] and write the code in Python.

questions.title: Explain quick sort
questions.question: Explain quicksort with the array [8, 3, 7, 1, 9, 2]. I want to see how the partition step moves elements around the pivot.

questions.title: Explain insertion sort
questions.question: Teach me insertion sort using [4, 3, 2, 10, 12, 1] as the example.

questions.title: Explain binary search

questions.title: Explain breadth first search
questions.example: edges A-B, A-C, B-D, C-D, D-E, start A
questions.question: Explain breadth first search on a graph with edges A-B, A-C, B-D, C-D, D-E starting from A. Show the queue at each step.

questions.title: Explain depth first search
questions.example: edges A-B, A-C, B-D, C-D, D-E, start A
questions.question: What is depth first search and how is it different from BFS? Use a small graph with edges A-B, A-C, B-D, C-D, D-E and start at A.

questions.title: Explain Dijkstra's algorithm
questions.example: A-B 3, A-C 8, B-C 2, B-D 5, C-D 4, start A
questions.question: Explain Dijkstra's algorithm on this graph: A-B 3, A-C 8, B-C 2, B-D 5, C-D 4, starting from A. Show the distance table after every step.

questions.title: Explain Kruskal's algorithm
questions.question: Explain Kruskal's algorithm for a minimum spanning tree with edges A-B 1, B-C 2, A-C 3, C-D 4. Why does it need union find?

questions.title: Explain topological sort
questions.question: Explain topological sort using Kahn's algorithm with the in-degree table. Use a DAG with edges A->C, B->C, C->D, D->E.

questions.title: Explain Floyd Warshall
questions.question: Explain the Floyd-Warshall all pairs shortest path algorithm on the graph A-B 3, A-C 8, B-C 2, B-D 5, C-D 4 and show how the distance matrix changes.

questions.title: Explain how a hash map works
questions.question: How does a hash map work internally? Explain hashing, buckets, and collisions by inserting the keys 12, 7, 22, 3 into a table with 5 buckets, and show a simple implementation in Python.

questions.title: Explain stacks and queues
questions.question: What is the difference between a stack and a queue? Show push and pop with the values 1, 2, 3 on both and write a Python class for each.

questions.title: Explain recursion with factorial
questions.question: Explain recursion using factorial(4) as the example. Show me the call stack growing and unwinding, then the code.

questions.title: Explain dynamic programming with Fibonacci
questions.question: Explain dynamic programming and memoization using fib(6). Show the recursion tree first, then how the memo table removes the repeated work.

questions.title: Explain reversing a linked list

questions.title: Explain BST insertion

questions.title: Explain a min heap
questions.question: Explain how a min-heap works. Insert 5, 3, 8, 1 one at a time, show the sift-up on the tree and the array underneath, then pop the minimum.

questions.title: Explain the sliding window technique
questions.question: Explain the sliding window technique. Find the maximum sum of any window of size k = 3 in [2, 1, 5, 1, 3, 2].

questions.title: Explain the two pointer technique
questions.question: Explain the two pointer technique on a sorted array. Find two numbers in [1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 11] that add up to 10 by moving pointers from opposite ends.
